invariants.rationale: The method dereferences batch to call setColor and is required to pass it to draw; thus, batch cannot be null at exit.
Width is used as a dimension argument for drawing; negative widths are likely disallowed.
Height is used as a dimension argument for drawing; negative heights are likely disallowed.
parentAlpha is used for alpha blending and is conventionally within [0,1] for valid alpha values.
The method accesses style and style.stageBackground, so they must not be null at this point.
